[[File:Saw detail.png|left|120px]]
A '''saw''' is a tool that can be purchased from the [[sawmill operator]] at the [[Lumber Yard]] located north-east of [[Varrock]] for 13 coins. It is used along with a [[hammer]] in the [[Construction]] skill to create [[furniture]]. A saw [[Item spawn|spawn]] can be found in the Varrock [[estate agent]]'s house, and they can also be obtained from a [[Tool store 1|tool store]].

The [[Crystal saw]], a reward from completing [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]], is functionally identical to the normal saw, but with the added bonus that it allows players to build furniture up to three levels above their Construction level when building furniture that requires both a hammer and a saw.

While the saw cannot be equipped, there is an equipable variant purchased with points earned from [[Mahogany Homes]] called [[Amy's saw]].

==Uses==
===Miniquests===
*[[Daddy's Home]]: 1 × saw to make furniture ([[Old Man Yarlo]] can give you one if not already owned)
